mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_BOARD_M (user_sq, board_ttl, board_description_edt, board_adopt_status_cd, board_typ, board_type_cd, board_category_cd, board_is_secret_yn) VALUES (#{userSq}, #{boardTtl}, #{boardDescriptionEdt}, 1501, #{boardTyp}, #{boardTypeCd}, #{boardCategoryCd}, COALESCE(#{boardIsSecretYn}, 'N'))
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_ttl = #{boardTtl}, board_description_edt = #{boardDescriptionEdt}, board_adopt_status_cd = #{boardAdoptStatusCd}, board_category_cd = #{boardCategoryCd}, board_is_secret_yn = COALESCE(#{boardIsSecretYn}, board_is_secret_yn), board_modified_at_dtm = NOW() WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_view_cnt = board_view_cnt + 1 WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_comment_cnt = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_BOARD_COMMENT_S WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq} AND comment_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq}
UPDATE TBL_BOARD_M SET board_recommend_cnt = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_RECOMMENDATION_S WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq} ) WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq}

mapper.select: SELECT file_sq FROM TBL_BOARD_ATTACHMENT_S WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_BOARD_ATTACHMENT_S WHERE board_sq = #{boardSq} AND file_sq = #{fileSq}
